pay_hardtostaff_schools_012.evidence: The District shall pay an incentive in the form of a $160 stipend to teachers who serve three (3) consecutive student days at a High Priority School or Special Education site. To receive the stipend, a short-call reserve teacher must serve three (3) consecutive student days at the same High Priority School or Special Education site.
